critical_code_review_comments: _prepopulate_grid correctly uses planned_start <= report_date <= planned_finish (no ±1 buffer) — verified with 5 mixed-date tasks, only the 3 spanning today are pre-populated.
Delay model now requires delay_days (Optional[float]); StrictModel extra='forbid' correctly rejects legacy delay_minutes payloads with 422.
register endpoint creates tenant + user + tenant_users membership atomically and seeds CSI taxonomy/cost rates via best-effort try/except — clean.
team_invites use 12-char code via secrets.token_urlsafe(9)[:12], 14-day expiry, single-use (status flips to 'accepted' on accept). Admin-only on POST/DELETE enforced.
accept-invite enforces email match (403), unknown code (404), expiry (410), and dup user (409) — all 4 paths verified.
DailyReports.jsx is 884 lines — still on the larger side; refactor into sub-components (header/weather/presence/grid/events/renovation/audit) is a future maintainability item, not blocking.

Login page bundle contains substring 'google' from third-party JS chunk filenames (e.g., googleapis Open Sans font import in tailwind/index). No visible Google login button in the rendered DOM — confirmed via screenshot. Cosmetic only; consider removing the unused google-fonts import in index.html for full hygiene if the user is sensitive.
